findings.body: The change from `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh;` to `use openhuman_core as oh;` alters the namespace resolution for all subsequent `oh::` imports in this file. Previously, `oh::integrations::IntegrationClient` resolved to `openhuman_core::openhuman::integrations::IntegrationClient`. Now it resolves to `openhuman_core::integrations::IntegrationClient`. If the `integrations`, `search`, and `tools` modules are not re-exported at the top level of `openhuman_core`, these imports will fail to compile. Please verify that the crate's public API matches this assumption, or update the remaining imports accordingly.
findings.title: Ensure that openhuman_core exports modules referenced via oh::

value.summary: This change adjusts the import alias from `openhuman_core::openhuman` to `openhuman_core`, which may break subsequent imports that depend on the previous namespace. The change appears intentional but could cause compilation errors if the crate's module structure does not match. One finding is raised regarding this potential issue.
